title: Verify: BootScene handles playAnimation and transitionTo unit tests
summary: Unit tests with Phaser mocked prove BootScene reacts to the React bus
description: Add a test file modelled on bootSceneCharacters.test.ts with the fake Phaser, emitting reactToPhaser events.
acceptance_criteria: playAnimation interact plays the interact key then idle
transitionTo calls cameras.main.fadeIn with the authored duration

steps.action: Create the file copying the vi.mock('phaser') fake, content mock and setup from bootSceneCharacters.test.ts (L1-L120). Add test 'playAnimation interact plays interact then idle': create BootScene, run create(), reactToPhaser.emit('playAnimation',{target:'boy',name:'interact'}), assert sprite.play was called with the interact key 'character:boy-interact:interact', invoke the captured ANIMATION_COMPLETE callback and assert play called with 'character:boy:idle'.

Add test 'transitionTo replays the fade': emit reactToPhaser 'transitionTo' {sceneId:'bedroom'} and assert cameras.main.fadeIn was called twice (create plus event) with the transition durationMs. Add test 'ignores events after shutdown': invoke the SHUTDOWN callback captured from events.once, clear spies, emit both events, assert sprite.play and fadeIn were not called.
